'''Yannick Lapointe Why Tamre look like Ketwol''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12435">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12435 Why Tamre look like Ketwol], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 20 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12435/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12435/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018082829/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12435/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 20 December 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Why Tamre look like Ketwol''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
